decisions.reason: The glazed industrial sectional door sits at the core of the firm's industrial door range, and having invested in its tooling, certification and catalogue presence, management will keep it and treat any weak sales as a temporary effect of the pandemic-era construction slowdown.
The insulated glazed variant fits the firm's announced push toward thermal and energy-efficient solutions, so the sunk development investment and its strategic fit make keeping it the natural choice.
This product was presented on its own website page, a visible public commitment within the core industrial segment, so management will keep it rather than reverse an earlier, prominent decision.
